      "band": "P1",
      "score": 0.8,
      "reason_tag": "DoS protection",
      "rationale": "Hardens P2P message handling against memory exhaustion attacks by enforcing a weight budget and pre-allocation checks during network stream deserialization. The description notes that for P2P streams, deserialization immediately rejects blocks and transactions exceeding the maximum block weight limit and drops transactions with zero inputs or outputs before allocating vector storage, preventing remote peers from inducing unvalidated memory spikes."

    },

      "name": "validation",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Redesigns CScriptWitness storage and transaction deserialization in src/primitives/transaction.h, src/script/script.h, and src/script/interpreter.cpp.",
      "band": "P1",
      "score": 0.85,
      "reason_tag": "DoS protection",
      "rationale": "Mitigates a reported adversarial resource exhaustion vulnerability where crafted 4 MB blocks consume over 180 MiB of RAM and hundreds of milliseconds to deserialize. The PR description notes the vulnerability was reported by furszy and 0xB10C; benchmarks show worst-case valid block deserialization time drops from 279 ms to 19 ms, with persisted block memory usage dropping from 106.8 MiB to 3.8 MiB and peak memory dropping from 182 MiB to 7.8 MiB."
    },
